Product Features

  • Compact size, versatile design: This shoe cabinet measures 70 x 24 x 120 cm. Thanks to its compact size, it blends harmoniously into entryways and other rooms without taking up much space, creating extra storage space in your home.
  • Multiple levels with hidden storage: Equipped with three shoe cabinets with folding doors, each divided into two compartments. Each compartment offers space for approx. 2-3 pairs of shoes (the exact number depends on the shoe model and size). A total of three hidden shoe compartments expand the storage space considerably and offer each shoe a safe place.
  • Practical drawers: The wide shelf offers space for keys, access cards and other small items you need on the go. This way, you always have these easy-to-lose items at hand.
  • Robust and durable: Made of medium-density fibreboard (MDF) and chipboard, the shoe cabinet has a recommended load capacity of 20 kg. The drawers offer space for several pairs of shoes and other items. It is sturdy and durable and does not deform even after prolonged use.
  • Simple and versatile white: The white surface looks simple and elegant and blends harmoniously with various furnishing styles such as modern and Scandinavian. It gives the entrance area a clean and fresh look and complements the overall style of the room.
  • Hinged doors for easy shoe access: Thanks to the folding doors, you always have your shoes at hand without having to bend down or turn around. In everyday life, simply open the door and quickly find the shoes you want – for more comfort.
  • Multi-level storage for optimal order: The multi-level interior layout makes it easy to sort and store shoes. Shoes of different styles and seasons can be neatly arranged, so that the shoe cabinet is clear at a glance and you can find your shoes quickly and easily.
  • Extensive storage space: From hidden shoe compartments to drawers and storage space at the bottom, the multi-tiered design provides ample space for shoes and small items, ensuring that the entryway remains neat and tidy at all times.
  • Note: Due to different shooting conditions and screen settings, there may be a slight color variation between the actual product and the image. This is normal and not a quality defect. We strive to reproduce the color of the product as accurately as possible. Please keep this in mind when placing your order.
